verdict.rationale: Extend's official CLI lists a dedicated `batch` command, and multifile extraction runs one extraction over a whole collection of files, so the product itself supports operating on many items at once. However, the batch command appears only as a menu entry with no documented semantics, limits, or concurrency behavior. Multifile extraction is a shared-context package run rather than a true bulk job over independent items. missing for 10: documented batch command behavior (inputs, concurrency, limits, per-item results), bulk API endpoints, bulk update/delete across resources, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
